name: ohmyjev
description: Guardrails for Codex, decided by Jev: blocks irreversible and data-leaking commands, even in full-auto, and runs them when you say yes.

interface.shortDescription: Jev-decided guardrails for Bash, edits and MCP calls.
interface.longDescription: Denies commands Jev rates irreversible or data-leaking, edits outside the repo or holding a credential, and MCP calls that send local data out. Flags prompt injection in tool output and pushes back on an unverified done. After a block, answer yes and that exact call runs.
